scope.complete_play_definition: all 22 distinct snap participants have one valid x/y observation at every integer 10 Hz frame from the manifest snap frame through the tracking terminal frame, inclusive

scope.terminal_and_carrier_use: terminal event and carrier candidate are descriptive target-side inventory labels, not cohort criteria, model inputs, or assignment labels
scope.unresolved_terminal: full-play completeness is unknown and remains a separate stratum; no end frame is inferred
